intro.text: An empire whose people combine mass production with Remembering to make complex works in quantity.
An empire sharing a continent with Teod, cut off from it by mountains. The Emperor of Eighty Suns rules it from the Rose Throne; Ashravan is the forty-ninth emperor of its dynasty.

description.text: Citizens rise through a system of ranks called reeds, each carrying its own requirements and privileges.
The empire trades with the states of Sycla, but its relations with Svorden are cooler; a table Svorden once sent as a gift to Ashravan's predecessor was locked away for that reason.

Its people believe there are eighty suns, a new one rising each day, and its government has eighty factions. Each faction is led by five arbiters, all of them Grands. When an emperor dies, the arbiters raise an agreed faction's candidate to the throne, and that faction's arbiters, the ruling arbiters, hold power second only to the emperor's.
